info.title: OpenDQV — validate one record
info.description: OpenAPI 3.0 description of POST /api/v1/validate, for registration as a Salesforce External Service. The API itself serves OpenAPI 3.1 at /openapi.json, which External Services does not accept; this file describes the one route a Screen Flow needs, with the request fields the API accepts and the response fields a flow branches on. Replace the servers URL with your endpoint before uploading. Authentication is a Bearer token in the Authorization header, carried by the External Credential.

servers.description: Replace with your OpenDQV base URL (no trailing slash)

post.summary: Validate one record against a contract
post.description: Returns HTTP 200 with the verdict. valid is the verdict in both modes; in observation-only mode a failing record still returns valid=false with would_have_failed=true, but the mode says it must not block — so a flow proceeds when valid is true OR mode is observation_only.

record.description: The record to validate, keyed by the contract's field names

record_id.description: Caller's correlation id — send the Salesforce record Id; it is echoed on the response

context.description: Caller-supplied tag recorded with quality stats, the audit event and metrics (e.g. 'demo', 'ci', 'salesforce'). Never changes which rules run (3.0.0: contracts carry no context overrides).

observe_only.description: Observation-only mode: the verdict is recorded but never blocks; the response's mode is observation_only

agent_id.description: Caller-asserted identity for attribution, e.g. the flow's name

valid.description: True when no blocking error fired. Proceed to Create Records on true, or when mode is observation_only

mode.description: The mode the verdict was produced in

would_have_failed.description: In observation-only mode: true when the record would have been rejected under enforcement

errors.description: Blocking failures — show these to the user

event_id.description: Audit primary key for this verdict
